name: @activepieces/piece-dimo
description: DIMO is an open protocol using blockchain to establish universal digital vehicle identity, permissions, data transmission, vehicle control, and payments. Developers use DIMO to build apps based on connected vehicles around the world while the vehicle owners benefit from monetizing their vehicle data.

auth.description: You can obtain following credentials by creating Developer License at [Developer Console](https://console.dimo.org/).

attestation-create-vin-vc.name: attestation-create-vin-vc
attestation-create-vin-vc.description: Generates the VIN VC for a given vehicle.

vehicleTokenId.description: The ID of the vehicle for generating VIN Verifiable Credential for.

aiMetadata.description: Generate a VIN Verifiable Credential (VIN VC) for a DIMO vehicle, identified by its numeric vehicle token ID. This is a minting/attestation call that produces a fresh signed credential each time, so it is not idempotent; use it when an agent needs an on-chain-verifiable attestation of a vehicle's VIN rather than just reading current VIN data.

device-definitions-decode-vin.name: device-definitions-decode-vin
device-definitions-decode-vin.description: Submits a decoding request for vehicle identification number, returns the device definition ID corresponding to the VIN.

aiMetadata.description: Decode a VIN (plus its 3-letter ISO country code) into a DIMO device definition ID identifying the make/model/year. A pure lookup that returns the same definition for the same VIN, so it is idempotent; pick it when you have a concrete VIN and need its canonical device definition, versus the Lookup action when you only have free-text make/model/year search terms.

device-definitions-lookup-device-definit.name: device-definitions-lookup-device-definitions
device-definitions-lookup-device-definit.description: Search for device definitions by query and filters.

makeSlug.description: Make of the vehicle (e.g. audi, lexus, etc)

modelSlug.description: Model of the vehicle (e.g. Tacoma, Accord, etc)

aiMetadata.description: Search the DIMO device-definition catalog by free-text query plus optional make/model/year filters, with pagination. Read-only search; pick it when you only have descriptive terms (e.g. "Lexus gx 2023") rather than a concrete VIN, in which case use Decode VIN instead.

token-exchange-get-vehicle-jwt.name: token-exchange-get-vehicle-jwt
token-exchange-get-vehicle-jwt.description: Creates a token exchange to obtain a Vehicle JWT.

vehicleTokenId.description: The ID of the vehicle for getting Vehicle JWT.

aiMetadata.description: Exchange the developer credentials for a short-lived Vehicle JWT scoped to a single vehicle token ID, which other DIMO calls need to read that vehicle's privileged data. Read-only token exchange with no side effects; pick it when you must obtain a vehicle-scoped access token directly rather than letting a higher-level action fetch one internally.

Run an arbitrary GraphQL query against the public DIMO Identity API (no auth required), passing the raw query string and optional variables. Read-only escape hatch for identity/ownership data not covered by the purpose-built Identity actions; prefer a specific Identity action when one fits and use this only for custom query shapes.

Get the total number of vehicles registered network-wide on DIMO. Read-only, no parameters, no auth; pick this for a global vehicle count, versus Get Total Vehicle Count For Owner when you need the count for one specific owner address.

identity-get-developer-license-info.name: identity-get-developer-license-info
identity-get-developer-license-info.description: Get developer license info by tokenId.

devLicenseTokenId.description: Token ID of the developer license.

aiMetadata.description: Look up details of a DIMO developer license by its numeric license token ID. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this when you have the license token ID, versus Get Vehicle By Dev License which queries by the license 0x address.

identity-get-vehicle-by-dev-license.name: identity-get-vehicle-by-dev-license
identity-get-vehicle-by-dev-license.displayName: Identity : Get Vehicle By Dev License
identity-get-vehicle-by-dev-license.description: Get vehicles by developer license 0x address.

aiMetadata.description: List vehicles associated with a developer license, identified by its 0x address. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this when you have the license 0x address, versus Get Developer License Info which looks up the license itself by token ID.

identity-get-total-vehicle-count-for-own.name: identity-get-total-vehicle-count-for-owner
identity-get-total-vehicle-count-for-own.displayName: Identity : Get Total Vehicle Count For Owner.
identity-get-total-vehicle-count-for-own.description: Get total vehicle count for an owner.

aiMetadata.description: Get the number of vehicles owned by a specific 0x Ethereum address on DIMO. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this for a per-owner count, versus Total Vehicle Count for the network-wide total or Get Owner Vehicles for the actual vehicle list.

identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-owner.name: identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-owner
identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-owner.displayName: Identity : Get Vehicle MMY By Owner
identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-owner.description: Get vehicle MMY by owner address.

aiMetadata.description: List the make/model/year (MMY) of every vehicle owned by a given 0x Ethereum address. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this when you have an owner address, versus Get Vehicle MMY By TokenId when you have a single vehicle token ID.

identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-tokenid.name: identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-tokenid
identity-get-vehicle-mmy-by-tokenid.displayName: Identity : Get Vehicle MMY By TokenId

vehicleTokenId.description: The ERC-721 token ID of the vehicle.

aiMetadata.description: Get the make/model/year (MMY) for a single vehicle by its ERC-721 token ID. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this when you have one vehicle token ID, versus Get Vehicle MMY By Owner to list MMY for all of an owner's vehicles.

identity-get-sacd-for-vehicle.name: identity-get-sacd-for-vehicle
identity-get-sacd-for-vehicle.description: Get SACD for a vehicle by tokenId.

vehicleTokenId.description: The ERC-721 token ID of the vehicle.

aiMetadata.description: Get the SACD permission grants (Service Access Contract Document, i.e. what data access has been shared) for a vehicle by its ERC-721 token ID. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this to inspect a vehicle's data-sharing permissions for a given vehicle token ID.

Get the current DIMO rewards for a given 0x Ethereum owner address. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this for current/aggregate reward state, versus Get Reward History By Owner for the historical breakdown over time.

identity-get-reward-history-by-owner.name: identity-get-reward-history-by-owner
identity-get-reward-history-by-owner.displayName: Identity : Get Reward History By Owner
identity-get-reward-history-by-owner.description: Get reward history by owner address.

aiMetadata.description: Get the historical DIMO reward records for a given 0x Ethereum owner address. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this for the time-series reward history, versus Get Rewards By Owner for the current reward summary.

identity-get-device-definition-by-tokeni.name: identity-get-device-definition-by-tokenid
identity-get-device-definition-by-tokeni.description: Get device definition by vehicle tokenId.

vehicleTokenId.description: The ERC-721 token ID of the vehicle

aiMetadata.description: Get the device definition (make/model/year specification) for a vehicle by its ERC-721 token ID. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this when you have a vehicle token ID, versus Get Device Definition By DefinitionId when you already hold a device definition ID string.

identity-get-device-definition-by-defini.name: identity-get-device-definition-by-definitionid
identity-get-device-definition-by-defini.displayName: Identity : Get Device Definition By DefinitionId

aiMetadata.description: Get a device definition directly by its device definition ID string. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this when you already have a definition ID (e.g. from Decode VIN or a Lookup), versus Get Device Definition which resolves it from a vehicle token ID.

identity-get-owner-vehicles.name: identity-get-owner-vehicles
identity-get-owner-vehicles.description: Get vehicles owned by an address.

aiMetadata.description: List the vehicles owned by a given 0x Ethereum address, including their token IDs. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this to enumerate an owner's actual vehicles, versus Get Total Vehicle Count For Owner if you only need the count.

identity-get-developer-shared-vehicles-f.name: identity-get-developer-shared-vehicles-from-owner
identity-get-developer-shared-vehicles-f.displayName: Identity : Get Developer Shared Vehicles From Owner
identity-get-developer-shared-vehicles-f.description: Get vehicles shared with a developer license from an owner.

aiMetadata.description: List the vehicles a given owner (0x address) has shared with a specific developer license (0x address), taking both addresses. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this to see the intersection of one owner's vehicles granted to one developer, versus Get Owner Vehicles (all of an owner's vehicles) or Get Vehicle By Dev License (all vehicles on a license).

List the DIMO Canonical Names (DCNs, human-readable vehicle name records) owned by a given 0x Ethereum address. Read-only and idempotent (no auth required); pick this to enumerate an owner's DCN name registrations by owner address.

telemetry-custom-query.name: telemetry-custom-query
telemetry-custom-query.description: Query DIMO Telemetry API using a custom GraphQL query.

aiMetadata.description: Run an arbitrary GraphQL query against the DIMO Telemetry API for one vehicle (by token ID), passing the raw query string and optional variables. Read-only escape hatch for telemetry data not covered by the purpose-built telemetry actions; pick a specific action (Signals, Daily Avg Speed, Max Speed, Events, VIN VC Latest) when one fits, and use this only for custom shapes.

telemetry-available-signals.name: telemetry-available-signals
telemetry-available-signals.description: Get a list of available signals for a specific vehicle.

aiMetadata.description: List which telemetry signals are available for a specific vehicle (by token ID), so an agent can discover what data the vehicle reports before querying values. Read-only and idempotent; pick this to enumerate signal names, not to retrieve their time-series values (use Signals for that).

telemetry-signals.name: telemetry-signals
telemetry-signals.description: Get a selection of available signals for a specific vehicle.

startDate.description: Start date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-07T12:00:00Z

endDate.description: End date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-09T12:00:00Z

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve telemetry signal values for a specific vehicle (by token ID) over a UTC start/end window, aggregated at a given interval (e.g. 1s, 1m, 1h). Read-only historical read; pick this for the vehicle's actual signal data over time, and use Available Signals first if you need to know which signals exist.

telemetry-daily-avg-speed.name: telemetry-daily-avg-speed
telemetry-daily-avg-speed.description: Get the average speed of a vehicle over a specific time period.

startDate.description: Start date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-07T12:00:00Z

endDate.description: End date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-09T12:00:00Z

aiMetadata.description: Get a vehicle's daily average speed over a UTC start/end window (by token ID). Read-only aggregate computed by DIMO, so it is idempotent; pick this for average-speed analytics, versus Max Speed for the peak value over the same period.

telemetry-event.name: telemetry-event
telemetry-event.description: Get the vehicle events over a specific time period.

startDate.description: Start date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-07T12:00:00Z

endDate.description: End date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-09T12:00:00Z

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve discrete vehicle events (e.g. trips, status changes) for a specific vehicle (by token ID) over a UTC start/end window. Read-only and idempotent; pick this for event records over a period rather than continuous signal samples (Signals) or speed aggregates (Daily Avg Speed / Max Speed).

telemetry-max-speed.name: telemetry-max-speed
telemetry-max-speed.description: Get the maximum speed of a vehicle over a specific time period.

startDate.description: Start date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-07T12:00:00Z

endDate.description: End date for the query in UTC, formatted as 2025-07-09T12:00:00Z

aiMetadata.description: Get a vehicle's maximum speed over a UTC start/end window at a given sampling interval (by token ID). Read-only aggregate, so it is idempotent; pick this for the peak speed reached, versus Daily Avg Speed for the average over the same period.

telemetry-vin-vc-latest.name: telemetry-vin-vc-latest
telemetry-vin-vc-latest.description: Get the latest VIN and Vehicle Configuration for a specific vehicle.

aiMetadata.description: Read the most recent VIN Verifiable Credential and vehicle configuration already on record for a specific vehicle (by token ID). Read-only and idempotent; pick this to fetch the existing latest VIN VC, versus the Attestation Create VIN VC action which mints a new credential.

List all DIMO Vehicle Events webhooks configured under the developer account. Read-only and idempotent; pick this to discover existing webhook IDs and their configuration before creating, updating, subscribing, or deleting.

vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-numeric-ac.name: vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-numeric-action
vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-numeric-ac.description: Create a new webhook or update existing one for numeric vehicle signals. If Webhook ID is provided, it will update; otherwise, it will create a new webhook.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to update. Leave empty to create a new webhook.

data.description: Which numeric vehicle signal to monitor

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

triggerNumber.description: Numeric value to compare against (e.g., speed in km/h, fuel percentage, battery watts, tire pressure in PSI)

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

targetURL.description: HTTPS endpoint URL that will receive webhook callbacks

displayName.description: Optional name to easily identify your webhook (defaults to webhook ID if not provided)

description.description: Brief description of the webhook conditions for your reference (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Create or update a Vehicle Events webhook that fires when a numeric signal (speed, fuel level, battery state of charge, tire pressure, etc.) crosses a threshold via an operator and trigger value. Supplying a Webhook ID updates that webhook (idempotent); omitting it creates a new one each call (not idempotent). Use the Boolean variant for on/off signals and the Events variant for driving events like harsh braking.

vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-boolean-ac.name: vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-boolean-action
vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-boolean-ac.description: Create a new webhook or update existing one for boolean vehicle signals. If Webhook ID is provided, it will update; otherwise, it will create a new webhook.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to update. Leave empty to create a new webhook.

data.description: Which boolean vehicle signal to monitor

triggerExpression.description: Boolean value to compare against (checked = true/charging, unchecked = false/not charging)

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

targetURL.description: HTTPS endpoint URL that will receive webhook callbacks

displayName.description: Optional name to easily identify your webhook (defaults to webhook ID if not provided)

description.description: Brief description of the webhook conditions for your reference (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Create or update a Vehicle Events webhook that fires on a boolean signal state (battery charging on/off, ignition on/off). Supplying a Webhook ID updates that webhook (idempotent); omitting it creates a new one each call (not idempotent). Use the Numeric variant for threshold signals and the Events variant for driving events.

vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-event-acti.name: vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-event-action
vehicle-events-upsert-webhook-event-acti.description: Create a new webhook or update existing one for vehicle events like harsh braking, acceleration, etc. If Webhook ID is provided, it will update; otherwise, it will create a new webhook.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to update. Leave empty to create a new webhook.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

targetURL.description: HTTPS endpoint URL that will receive webhook callbacks

displayName.description: Optional name to easily identify your webhook (defaults to webhook ID if not provided)

description.description: Brief description of the webhook conditions for your reference (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Create or update a Vehicle Events webhook that fires on discrete driving events (extreme/harsh braking, harsh acceleration, harsh cornering). Supplying a Webhook ID updates that webhook (idempotent); omitting it creates a new one each call (not idempotent). Use the Numeric or Boolean variants instead when monitoring signal values rather than driving events.

Permanently delete a Vehicle Events webhook by its Webhook ID, removing it and its vehicle subscriptions. Destructive and not idempotent (deleting an already-removed webhook errors); pick this to tear down a webhook rather than disabling it via the Status field on a Create/Update action.
List the signal names available for use in Vehicle Events webhook conditions. Read-only and idempotent; pick this to discover valid signals before creating or updating a numeric/boolean webhook.

vehicle-events-list-subscribed-vehicles-.name: vehicle-events-list-subscribed-vehicles-action
vehicle-events-list-subscribed-vehicles-.description: List vehicles subscribed to a webhook.

aiMetadata.description: List the vehicles currently subscribed to a given webhook, taking the Webhook ID. Read-only and idempotent; pick this to see which vehicles a webhook covers, versus List Vehicle Subscriptions which goes the other direction (all webhooks a single vehicle is subscribed to).

vehicle-events-list-vehicle-subscription.name: vehicle-events-list-vehicle-subscriptions-action
vehicle-events-list-vehicle-subscription.description: List all subscriptions for a vehicle.

aiMetadata.description: List all webhook subscriptions for a single vehicle, taking the vehicle Token ID. Read-only and idempotent; pick this to see which webhooks one vehicle is subscribed to, versus List Subscribed Vehicles which lists all vehicles on a given webhook.

vehicle-events-subscribe-vehicle-action.name: vehicle-events-subscribe-vehicle-action
vehicle-events-subscribe-vehicle-action.description: Subscribe a vehicle to a webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Subscribe one vehicle (by Token ID) to a specific webhook (by Webhook ID) so it begins firing for that vehicle. A targeted mutation; pick this for a single vehicle, versus Subscribe All Vehicles to enroll every eligible vehicle on the developer license at once.

vehicle-events-subscribe-all-vehicles-ac.name: vehicle-events-subscribe-all-vehicles-action
vehicle-events-subscribe-all-vehicles-ac.description: Subscribe all vehicles to a webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Subscribe every eligible vehicle on the developer license to a given webhook (by Webhook ID) in one call. A bulk mutation that affects all vehicles; pick Subscribe Vehicle instead when you only need a single vehicle enrolled.

vehicle-events-unsubscribe-vehicle-actio.name: vehicle-events-unsubscribe-vehicle-action
vehicle-events-unsubscribe-vehicle-actio.description: Unsubscribe a vehicle from a webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Remove one vehicle (by Token ID) from a specific webhook (by Webhook ID) so it stops firing for that vehicle. A targeted mutation; pick this for a single vehicle, versus Unsubscribe All Vehicles to detach every vehicle from the webhook at once.

vehicle-events-unsubscribe-all-vehicles-.name: vehicle-events-unsubscribe-all-vehicles-action
vehicle-events-unsubscribe-all-vehicles-.description: Unsubscribe all vehicles from a webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Remove every subscribed vehicle from a given webhook (by Webhook ID) in one call, leaving the webhook itself intact. A bulk mutation; pick Unsubscribe Vehicle instead when you only need to detach a single vehicle.

battery-is-charging-trigger.name: battery-is-charging-trigger
battery-is-charging-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle battery charging status changes (True/False).

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

chargingState.description: Trigger when battery starts or stops charging

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle's traction-battery charging status matches the selected state (charging = true, or not charging = false). Each event represents a single charging-status telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, a boolean isCharging flag, and a CHARGING/NOT CHARGING label. Use to detect when a vehicle starts or stops charging.

battery-power-trigger.name: battery-power-trigger
battery-power-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle battery current power meets the specified condition.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

powerWatts.description: The battery power in watts to compare against.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle reports a traction-battery current-power reading (watts) that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single battery-power telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, power in watts/kilowatts, and a derived status (Charging when negative, Discharging when positive, Idle). Use to monitor instantaneous battery power draw or charge flow.

charge-level-trigger.name: charge-level-trigger
charge-level-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle battery charge level meets the specified condition.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

chargePercentage.description: The battery charge level as a percentage (0-100) to compare against.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored electric/hybrid vehicle reports a traction-battery state-of-charge reading (percent, 0-100) that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single charge-level telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, charge percentage, and a derived level (High/Medium/Low/Critical) plus low/critical-battery flags. Use to detect a battery falling below or rising above a target charge.

fuel-absolute-level-trigger.name: fuel-absolute-level-trigger
fuel-absolute-level-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle fuel system absolute level meets the specified condition.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

fuelLiters.description: The fuel level in liters to compare against.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle reports a fuel-system absolute level reading (liters) that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single absolute fuel-level telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, and the fuel volume in liters and gallons. Use to detect when fuel volume drops below or rises above a specific amount.

fuel-relative-level-trigger.name: fuel-relative-level-trigger
fuel-relative-level-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle fuel system relative level meets the specified condition.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty or select All Vehicles to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

fuelPercentage.description: The fuel level as a percentage (0-100) to compare against.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle reports a fuel-system relative level reading (percent of tank capacity, 0-100) that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single relative fuel-level telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, and the fuel percentage. Use to detect a fuel tank dropping below or rising above a percentage threshold.

ignition-trigger.name: ignition-trigger
ignition-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle ignition status changes (ON/OFF).

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

ignitionState.description: Trigger when ignition turns ON or OFF.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle's ignition status matches the selected state (ON or OFF). Each event represents a single ignition telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, a boolean isIgnitionOn flag, and an ON/OFF label. Use to detect when a vehicle is started or shut off (e.g. trip start/end).

odometer-trigger.name: odometer-trigger
odometer-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle odometer meets the specified condition.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

odometerValue.description: The odometer value in kilometers to compare against.

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle reports a travelled-distance (odometer) reading in kilometers that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single odometer telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, and the distance in km and miles. Use to detect when a vehicle reaches a mileage milestone (e.g. service interval).

speed-trigger.name: speed-trigger
speed-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle speed meets specified conditions.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

speedValue.description: Speed value to compare against in kilometers per hour

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle reports a speed reading (km/h) that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single speed telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, and the measured speed value. Use to detect speeding, movement, or a vehicle coming to a stop.

tire-pressure-trigger.name: tire-pressure-trigger
tire-pressure-trigger.description: Triggers when vehicle tire pressure meets the specified condition.

vehicleTokenIds.description: List of vehicle token IDs to monitor (leave empty to monitor all vehicles with permissions).

operator.description: How to compare the battery power in watts

pressureKpa.description: The tire pressure in kilopascals to compare against

coolDownPeriod.description: Minimum number of seconds between successive webhook firings

aiMetadata.description: Fires via DIMO webhook when a monitored vehicle reports a tire-pressure reading (kPa) for the selected wheel position (front/rear, left/right) that satisfies the configured comparison operator against the threshold. Each event represents a single tire-pressure telemetry signal and includes the vehicle token ID, timestamp, pressure in kPa/PSI/bar, and a derived Low/Normal/High status. Use to detect under- or over-inflated tires.

nl.DIMO is an open protocol using blockchai: DIMO is een open protocol met behulp van blockchain om de universele identiteit van digitale voertuigen vast te stellen, machtigingen, gegevensoverdracht, voertuigcontrole en betalingen. pt.DIMO is an open protocol using blockchai: DIMO é um protocolo aberto, que utiliza a blockchain para estabelecer a identidade digital universal do veículo, permissões, transmissão de dados, controle de veículos e pagamentos.
